paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim, chapter 3, halakhah 1; Vayikra Rabbah 15:4 has Rabbi Tanchum Batzrurvaya in Rabbi Yirmeyah’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 3:1 has Tanchum Botzraya. The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital Vayikra Rabbah 15:4 has a different Batzruraya form and reports him in Yirmeyah’s name. The supplied name forms remain distinct; the compressed malformed Jerusalem Talmud abbreviation is expanded contextually, without a printed-letter history claim.

The whole Guggenheimer Kilayim 3:1 paragraph names Rabbi Tanchum Botzraya, and the whole Torat Emet Vayikra Rabbah 15:4 paragraph names Rabbi Tanchum Batzruraya in Rabbi Yirmeyah’s name. Those local full titles are supported. The heading retains the supplied Bitzrayya form rather than establishing a modern place identification. The distinct forms and existing note remain without a printed-letter correction history.
